notebook:
Goal: maximize (revenue-cost)/439. Empty=0. Max pure $3615M/yr; blend ceiling ~$3246M/yr.
Blend revenues ($M/yr): C3mix 73, C4mix 186, C5mix 618, C6par 1180, C6nap 396; pure nC7 332, nC8 358, nC9 103, C2 4.
Volatility order: C2 | C3mix | C4mix | C5mix | C6par | C6nap | nC7 | nC8 | nC9.
Costs: 30st R0.5=$61M; 45st R3=$195M; 60st R6=$253M; 100st R8=$445M. Reflux dominates cost.
Gaps(K): C4/C5 28 easy, C5/C6par 14, C6par/C6nap ~3 (brutal), C6/C7 18, C7/C8 27, C8/C9 25 easy; tight: C3 6, iC4/nC4 12.
KEY FAILURE: 100st R8 feed col still gave NO stream >=95%. T=40% C4mix, B=C6+ mix. Sharp single-component purity seems very hard.
NEW IDEA: side draws can deliver a middle cut (blend) from ONE column. Try low-reflux 60st col with liquid side draw to see where the middle cut lands and its purity. If C5mix or C6par middle cut reaches >=95%, one-column blend is hugely profitable.
Plan: 1) probe side-draw location/purity cheaply. 2) if promising, tune stage/fraction/phase. 3) build minimal cascade only where needed.
